description: Search active Homejourney Singapore property listings for deep-research and citation hosts. Broad availability questions are supported; use location, project, or feature keywords only when the user supplied them. Returns canonical listing URLs for citations. When no listing matches, returns the Homejourney guides that answer the question (IDs starting guide:), or an empty list with a note naming the next tool. To filter by price, bedrooms, area or rent terms, use search_listings instead.
name: search

note.description: Set only when results is empty: why, and which tool to call next.

title: Find Homejourney listings to cite
